title: Um Tickets zu gewinnen
notes: PDF page 35 (code 34). Extracted 2026-07-07 using poppler's pdftotext -bbox for text (word segmentation and German spelling verified reliable — pdf.js's own text layer was found to split/misspell words on this PDF's font, e.g. "Bundesfamilienministerium" was corrupted to "Bundesfamilienministirium"/"D eutsch lands") combined with pixel-sampled color classification (renders each page at 300dpi and samples actual ink RGB at each word's exact position) rather than the PDF's internal fill-color operator sequence, which was found to desync on pages with a corrupted/remapped font and silently misattribute colors between statements — the root cause of widespread wrong answers in earlier import passes. GREEN ink = Richtig, everything else = Falsch, per user's explicit manual-answer-key convention. Pale highlight washes and red Arabic annotation text are excluded from color classification and from the statement text entirely (personal notes, not exam content). Verified letter-by-letter against source images on 6+ pages spanning the full range (2, 7, 16, 22, 29, 30, 38, 40, 42) with zero spelling or answer discrepancies remaining.

statements.text: Um Tickets zu gewinnen, muss man wissen, wann die Veranstaltung ist.
In nur 11 Tagen spielte der Film "Jurassic World" außerhalb der USA mehr als 700 Millionen Dollar ein.
In Kärnten kann es aufgrund von starkem Gegenverkehr zu Verzögerungen kommen.
Aufgrund einer Kaltfront sinkt die Schneefallgrenze entlang der Alpennordseite knapp unter 2000 m herab.
Mit Frankreich gegen Kanada steht das erste Viertelfinale der Frauenfußball- WM fest.
